title: Mouse Genotyping with KAPA Kit
author: Cq Wu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bbxnipme

steps.title: Collect Mouse Tissues
steps.instruction: Collect mouse ear or tail clips into PCR strips.

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 µL of extraction buffer mix for each sample.

steps.title: Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of buffer to each tissue sample and perform the extraction reaction.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the DNA extract and spin down before proceeding to PCR

steps.title: Prepare PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare 20 µL of PCR master mix for each sample.

steps.title: Run PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the PCR reaction using the following thermal cycling parameters.

substeps.instruction: 35 cycles of: 95 °C for 15 seconds, 57 °C (adjustable) for 15 seconds, and 72 °C for 10 seconds per kb

steps.title: Analyze DNA Gel
steps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the PCR reaction and run it on a DNA gel.
